hints.title: Post-Order Subtree Summing
hints.text: A node must be evaluated after both its left and right subtrees have computed their aggregate values.

hints.title: Descendant Sum Comparison
hints.text: The sum of descendants is the sum of all node values in the left subtree plus all node values in the right subtree.

hints.title: Recursive Sum Propagation
hints.text: Return left_sum + right_sum + node.val up to the parent while incrementing the match counter whenever node.val == left_sum + right_sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: count of nodes in binary tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subtree sums independently for each node takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Post-order recursion computes each subtree sum once bottom-up in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement clean bottom-up post-order aggregation.
